objects.name: CISA Urges Immediate Patching of Exploited TrueConf Vulnerabilities
objects.description: The Head Mare hacktivist group has been exploiting the bugs to deploy the PhantomCore malware. The post CISA Urges Immediate Patching of Exploited TrueConf Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .
